documentation.content: The recipe provider setup (pictures, and the text when a profile carries it) was switched from the owner console (`provider_profile_changed`, with `from`, `to`, `provider`, `model`, `textProvider` when the text is not the default, `uidHash`). If you did not switch it, switch back on the console or with `npm run admin -- providers use <profile> --apply`, remove the account from `config/owner`, and read `providerProfileChanges/` in the Firestore console. See functions/README.md, "Provider profiles" and "The owner console". Switches made with the admin command are logged to the `admin` log and not alerted on.
